description: Two genuinely different settings (different settingDefinitionId) that happen to compute the same cspPath must NOT be merged — confirmed for real against a live tenant's catalog: Graph's definition-level cspPath is templated ({0}/[{0}] placeholders for collection items), so distinct sibling definitions in a parameterized group can render the identical literal path (e.g. an app-level and a Safari-specific camera-permission setting both showing as "Privacy/PermissionDefaults/{0}/Camera"). Keyed on settingDefinitionId specifically so this doesn't produce a false conflict.
